title: Chapter 1403 - 558: Thousand Hammers Lord Repairs the Furnace
content:
Chapter 1403: Chapter 558: Thousand Hammers Lord Repairs the Furnace

Seeing Ning Zhuo successfully calm the Vermilion Bird Artifact Spirit at this moment, Wang Yu almost stood up, his eyes flashing with brilliance!

"My decision last night was correct!"

"Since Ning Zhuo made such a request through the Commerce Hall, he must have a certain grasp. He has already gained the recognition of Zhong Dao from the Evil Slaying Hall, and can unleash such a surging Vast Energy, he must not act without a purpose, nor is he a selfish person who only looks out for his own interests."

"That’s why I didn’t accept the sequence change."

"Sure enough, I managed to squeeze out his real trump card."

Wang Yu sighed deeply.

The world is vast, and it is full of talented people.

"Ning Zhuo is merely a small Foundation Establishment Cultivator, yet he can achieve what the entire Myriad Images Sect cannot."

"Indeed, I did not move the sect’s profound resources beyond Nascent Soul for the matter of the Nanming Fire Furnace."

These beings wouldn’t act for a mere Spiritual Treasure.

"But Ning Zhuo truly did it!"

At this moment, Wang Yu found himself resonating deeply with Zhong Dao’s recognition and emphasis on Ning Zhuo.

Ning Zhuo’s ability to communicate and calm the Vermilion Bird Artifact Spirit was a complete qualitative transformation!

Artifact Refining Hall Master Tie Kuang, and even Danxia Peak and the Alchemy Hall, all actually have the ability to repair the Nanming Fire Furnace.

The repair of the furnace’s body itself was never an obstacle or difficulty.

The real challenge was the Vermilion Bird Artifact Spirit.

The Artifact Spirit was so heavily frightened that even a slight movement would scare it to death.

Tie Kuang’s judgment was acknowledged by Wang Yu and others.

Whoever could solve the problem of the Vermilion Bird Artifact Spirit could save the entire Nanming Fire Furnace.

Now, Ning Zhuo had done it!

It wasn’t just Wang Yu; many cultivators behind Ning Zhuo also noticed this, thus exclaiming in surprise.

How did a little Foundation Establishment Cultivator achieve this?

Countless sharp gazes were fixed tightly on the Spirit Communication Mirror in Ning Zhuo’s hand.

Since the Spirit Communication Mirror came into existence, it had never received such attention before!

Everyone wanted to see the Spirit Communication Mirror clearly!

If it weren’t for the Xingyun Trial, and the interference with divine senses being an issue that might disturb Ning Zhuo, there would have already been countless divine senses sweeping Ning Zhuo and the Spirit Communication Mirror by now.

On the outer layer, many cultivators in the audience also erupted in exclamations.

They didn’t expect the first participating cultivator in the trial to make such a huge impact!

"Ning Zhuo can actually soothe the Vermilion Bird Artifact Spirit? Did I see it wrong?!"

"He really is a genius!"

"This isn’t something a mere genius can accomplish. Didn’t you see other Nascent Soul, Golden Core cultivators looking dumbfounded?"

"Even the current Artifact Refining Hall Master Tie Kuang is helpless, doesn’t it mean that Ning Zhuo is stronger than Tie Kuang in this aspect?"

"Stronger than Tie Kuang? Haven’t you noticed Danxia Peak and the Alchemy Hall rushing to hold this Xingyun Trial?"

"Ning Zhuo possesses such ability in artifact refining? It’s simply unbelievable!"

"No, more accurately, his ability to communicate and soothe the Artifact Spirit is the key!"

"How exactly did he do it?"

The endless discussions continued, leaving everyone bewildered and greatly shocked.

Chun Yangzi’s face was stern, watching Ning Zhuo’s back, his eyes full of seriousness.

The red hair of the Nine Fire Dragon Lord fluttered in the wind, but his mood was heavy, as Ning Zhuo’s performance gave him an unprecedented sense of crisis.

Tao Liang could no longer remain calm with his eyes closed, he opened them, staring at Ning Zhuo.

Dong Nishang smiled, thinking, "No wonder he is valued by our Confucian Cultivator Group." Her mind was the most relaxed, knowing she had already given her all previously, making this fourth round just a formality.

If Ning Zhuo ultimately won, it would be something Dong Nishang, and the entire Confucian Cultivator Group, welcomed.

In any case, no one dared to underestimate Ning Zhuo anymore. At this moment, any cultivator participating in this Xingyun Trial focused intensely on Ning Zhuo, seeing him as the most formidable competitor!

Ning Zhuo began officially repairing the Pill Furnace.

His Divine Sense surged like a tide, drawing out each Spirit Line from the Refining Furnace, carefully "weaving" them into the cracks on the furnace wall.

These Spirit Lines had the Nine Heavens Profound Iron as their bone, and Purple Mansion Spiritual Liquid as their blood, subsequently refined with Flowing Cloud Sand, Taibai Gold Essence, Heavenly Crystal, Thick Earth, and other precious treasures, each shimmering with extraordinary radiance and essence.

Each Spirit Line was precisely embedded by Ning Zhuo into every crack, then rapidly refined to repair the Pill Furnace. Ning Zhuo’s actions were skillful and steady, neither rushed nor overly cautious, missing not a fraction.

His Divine Sense and Mana were consumed crazily, quickly turning Ning Zhuo’s face pale, with fine sweat beads emerging on his forehead.

The cracks on the furnace wall gradually diminished under the sewing of the Spirit Lines.

From finger-width to line-width, from line-width to thread-width, from thread-width to nothing.

Some charred edges gradually faded under the nourishment of Starlight, revealing a dark red color, akin to a dormant volcano.

Chun Yangzi, Cang Yazi, and others, being closer, witnessed the entire process, all moved.

"This child’s artifact refining technique is outstanding, hard to imagine he is just a Foundation Establishment Mid-Stage cultivator."

"How old is he? So young, yet with such accomplishments?"

"Not impossible. I’ve indeed heard of some geniuses capable of this level. However... such individuals usually become renowned nationwide, a genius of national level!"

"Wasn’t Ning Zhuo the one who defeated Gu Qing? He ought to be a national-level genius."

The last Spirit Line successfully embedded into the crack, refined, and filled the gap. Ning Zhuo sighed softly, slowly easing off.

"Come on, little treasure, let’s get intimate for a bit." Ning Zhuo, on the surface, used the Spirit Communication Mirror with a slight shake, but in reality, he quietly used the Life Hanging Thread to issue a command.
